case_title: SUN FENG VS METROPOLITAN LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY SUN FENG AS TO DEFENDANT METROPOLITAN LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-11-1991 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 02
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
PAT DOLAN SIGNED FOR JACK WICKWARE

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SUN FENG IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT METROPOLITAN LIFE INSURANCE COMPANY STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
